title: AshDash's Mild Realism
description: The modpack adds Everything to have realism With keeping the Vanilla Game At Heart. Go With the Vanilla feel, choose This
body:
AshDash's mild realism is a modpack that brings a lot of mods that could be beleivable as a gamedrop or a new update in the future. you dont need to get used to it because it keeps the vanilla game With only a Few Exeptions but never changing anything that major. 
A few Things That are changed:
- Animations
- new mobs
- diving
- terrain slabs
- sword combat
- gui improvments
- physics mod
